brand.tagline: A journal for every kind of day

hero.eyebrow: Mood, memory and the moments between
hero.title: Notice the day.
hero.description: Bring your mood, emotions, dreams, notes, movement, people and music into one calm daily entry — then watch your days become a story.

preview.question: How did today feel?
preview.summary: A calm day with a little spark.

modules.title: One entry. Every side of you.
modules.description: Keep only the sections that feel useful and arrange them in the order that fits your journaling rhythm.

mood.title: Mood
mood.description: Choose the feeling that shaped the day.

emotions.title: Emotions
emotions.description: Capture the more nuanced feelings underneath.

doodle.title: Doodle
doodle.description: Draw the part of the day words cannot hold.

dream.title: Dream
dream.description: Remember a dream and the story around it.

note.title: Note
note.description: Write the small detail you want to keep.

people.title: People
people.description: Remember who shared the day with you.

music.title: Music
music.description: Attach the track that sounded like today.

world.title: A journal that grows with you.
world.description: Calendar, themes, insights and widgets turn small daily check-ins into a personal rhythm.

calendar.title: Calendar & Day Glance
calendar.description: Move through saved days and see each entry as a compact visual summary.

streak.title: Gentle Streaks
streak.description: See current and longest streaks without turning reflection into pressure.

themes.title: Mood Themes
themes.description: Choose Classic, Cosmos, Garden, Arcade or Ocean for a mood language that feels yours.

widgets.title: Home Screen Widgets
widgets.description: Quick add, streak, weekly entries and calendar views stay close on the Home Screen.

cta.title: Your days deserve more than a blur.

social.title: Some days are better shared.
